name: AXM Entry Resource Closure Observatory
actions: read each top-level module manifest and its declared HTML entry
extract a finite set of static quoted script style and media references
presence-check local targets without reading their bodies
separate local missing paths from remote runtime dynamic and safety-held references
emit a freshness-bound entry resource closure map
follow bounded static HTML CSS and JavaScript references into a transitive graph
hash local text nodes and record cycles limits and unresolved edges without execution
summary: Read-only direct closure plus a bounded transitive static resource graph for manifest-declared human HTML entries.
notes: The direct v1 map still reads referenced files as metadata only. The v0.2 graph separately reads bounded local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript text for static pattern extraction and hashing. It does not build syntax trees, execute code, resolve dynamic or bare package references, fetch networks, load a browser, render, decode media, prove readiness, or change CANON.
